title: Everest Marathon 2027: course maps and checkpoints — third-party compiled reference (goatmaps)
publisher: goatmaps.com (third-party route compilation, not the event organiser)
claims: The first race was a test run on 19 May 2003; the organiser counts 2027 as its 22nd edition.

The 70K and full marathon start at Everest Base Camp, about 5,364 m, after two nights in tents on the Khumbu Glacier; the half marathon starts at Dingboche; all three finish in Namche Bazaar at 3,440 m.
Third-party-compiled 70K cutoffs: Pangboche 11:30 AM, Machhermo 5:00 PM, Namche 11:59 PM; the full and half share the Tengboche 4:00 PM cutoff listed on the event page.
Each race page shows an embedded AllTrails map, but no GPX is available to download and no aid-station list is published; the map lines begin a little over a kilometre up the glacier from Base Camp.
